name: AnobikDock
author: Md Rahat

sections.description:
AnobikDock allows WordPress administrators and web developers to upload static zip builds from modern frontend frameworks (React, Vue, Next.js, Vite, HTML/CSS) and publish them directly as clean, custom-URL landing pages on their WordPress site.

Whether you build landing pages using React, Vue, Next.js static exports, Vite, or classic HTML/CSS, AnobikDock extracts and serves your static site instantly with zero theme conflict or performance overhead.

Key Features

  • Upload Any Build ZIP: Upload static export zips created from Vite, React, Vue, Next.js, HTML, or Tailwind CSS.
  • Pure Standalone High Performance: Zero theme conflict. Renders 100% clean static HTML without loading heavy theme assets.
  • WordPress Core Pages Sync: Imported pages automatically register with wp_posts (Pages > All Pages) for seamless SEO plugin & navigation menu compatibility.
  • Responsive Live Preview Modal: Preview imported landing pages directly inside your dashboard with Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile viewport switchers.
  • Dynamic SEO & Social Meta Injection: Customize SEO Page Title, Meta Description, and OpenGraph (OG) Share Image for every landing page.
  • Analytics & Pixel Integration: Built-in, secure Google Analytics (GA4) and Facebook Pixel integration.
  • Security & Performance First: Built with strict Nonce verification, capability checks, path traversal protection, and safe ZIP extraction.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the anobik-dock folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP file directly via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to AnobikDock in the admin menu to start uploading and publishing your landing pages.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with React, Vue, or Next.js static builds?

Yes! Export your frontend project using static build commands (npm run build or next export), compress the dist folder into a ZIP, and upload it directly.

Will imported pages override my active theme styling?

No. In Standalone Mode, theme CSS/JS is completely bypassed so your imported design looks exactly as created.

Where are the uploaded files saved?

Files are extracted safely into wp-content/uploads/anobik-dock/ with executable PHP script execution blocking enabled.
